title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: MCP-based agents for US Government clouds
summary: The roadmap facts, agent-blocking path, API and general licensing statements are supported. However, the blanket statement that government-cloud MCP controls are undocumented overlooks Microsoft's documented tenant-wide tool-access controls in GCC; their applicability to GCC High, DoD and individual MCP integration routes remains a separate question.

claims.quote: We’re introducing support for Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot .

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 admin center path is Agents > All agents > agent > Block > Block agent > Save.
claims.quote: Select Agents > All agents. ... select an agent from the list of agents. ... select Block or Unblock. ... select either Block agent or Unblock agent, and then select Save.

claims.claim: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block blocks the selected package.
claims.quote:
Block a Copilot package to prevent its usage.
POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block
Don't supply a request body for this method.

claims.claim: The agent block control restricts use of the selected agent across the organisation.
claims.quote: Block and unblock | Restrict access to an agent across the organization, preventing any user from using it.

claims.claim: Blocking the selected agent does not necessarily block a shared MCP server.
claims.quote: These actions apply to the selected agent. If the agent is included in a plugin, don't assume the action also applies to the whole plugin package, its skills, shared MCP servers, or connections.

claims.claim: Agent blocking does not necessarily revoke connected-service permissions or credentials.
claims.quote: Agent approval or blocking doesn't necessarily grant or revoke connected-service permissions or credentials.

claims.claim: Learn describes organisation-wide agent blocking as using the same controls as other apps in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: Block or unblock agents for the entire organization by using the same controls that work for any other app in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: The cited user-interface page gives no equivalent cloud-specific statement confirming agent blocking in DoD.
claims.quote: Searched: DoD, government, GCCH and GCCM in the fetched agent-actions page. Its cloud note supports publishing in GCCH/GCCM; the block section gives a general procedure, not a DoD availability statement.
